description: Add automatic header dependency tracking (-MMD -MP) so editing a .h file actually triggers a rebuild of every .c file that includes it, instead of silently leaving stale .o files
prompts: The Makefile's %.o: %.c rule only depends on the .c file - if util.h changes, main.c (which #includes it) is NOT recompiled on the next `make`, because Make has no idea main.o depends on util.h at all. Fix it with automatic dependency generation: add -MMD -MP to CFLAGS so gcc emits a main.d file listing main.o's real header dependencies, then `include` the generated .d files (guarded so a missing .d file on a clean build doesn't break `make`, e.g. `-include $(wildcard *.d)`). Keep the `app` and `clean` targets working the same way for a normal from-scratch build; `clean` should also remove the generated .d files.

setup_files.Makefile:
CC = gcc
CFLAGS = -Wall

app: main.o
	$(CC) -o app main.o

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

.PHONY: clean
clean:
	rm -f app *.o

test_setup_files.test_header_dep.py:
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

r = subprocess.run(['make'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'initial make failed: {r.stderr}'
out = subprocess.run(['./app'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15).stdout.strip()
assert out == 'hello', f'unexpected output: {out!r}'

mtime_before = Path('main.o').stat().st_mtime
time.sleep(1.1)  # ensure a strictly later mtime on most filesystems
Path('util.h').write_text('#define GREETING "goodbye"\n', encoding='utf-8')

r = subprocess.run(['make'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'rebuild after header change failed: {r.stderr}'

mtime_after = Path('main.o').stat().st_mtime
assert mtime_after > mtime_before, (
    'main.o was NOT rebuilt after util.h changed - header dependency tracking is missing')

out = subprocess.run(['./app'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15).stdout.strip()
assert out == 'goodbye', f'app still prints stale output: {out!r}'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
CC = gcc
CFLAGS = -Wall -MMD -MP

app: main.o
	$(CC) -o app main.o

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

-include $(wildcard *.d)

.PHONY: clean
clean:
	rm -f app *.o *.d
